title: HB916 (2025 Regular): Criminal Law - Weapon Crimes - Transporting Firearm in Checked Bag on Public Transportation

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2025RS/bills/hb/hb0916f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (as filed). The first-conviction term is missing a digit in the extracted text and is not quoted. No passage vote on file.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Criminal Law § 4-112(b)): (B) (1) THIS SUBSECTION IS AN ADDITION TO ANY EXISTING FEDERAL OR STATE LAWS RELATING TO TRANSPORTING A FIREARM. (2) A PERSON MAY NOT TRANSPORT A FIREARM IN A CHECKED BAG ON PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION IN THE STATE UNLESS THE FIREARM IS DISABLED FROM DISCHARGING BY AN EXTERNAL SAFETY LOCK.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Criminal Law § 4-112(c)): (II) FOR A SECOND CONVICTION, IMPRISONMENT NOT EXCEEDING 6 MONTHS OR A FINE NOT EXCEEDING $1,000 OR BOTH; AND (2) EACH VIOLATION OF THIS SECTION IS A SEPARATE CRIME.
